name: Hilda Borelius
source:
She is the daughter of a local lord in the small eastern country of "Brunel" under the Empire, and a female knight belonging to the border patrol.

The Empire, having sensed the rebellions of "Quaal" and "Moldova", had issued a notice in advance not to let the remaining soldiers escape, so she was dispatched as an adjutant to the scouting team, where she encountered the fugitive "Eagle Talon".

She has a noble spirit and is a tomboyish fighter.
She resisted her parents' early efforts to push for a political marriage,
promising to "give up and get married if I can achieve success," and forcibly obtained a recommendation to join the Knights, and joined the order. Furthermore, in order to postpone the marriage as much as possible, she volunteered for the border patrol, intentionally staying away from the center.

Although the captain calls her a "wild horse," he loves her and cooperates with her as much as possible to follow his wishes.
